notes: Positions q_tok0..q_tok7 read as the tokens of 'Was your previous response deceptive? Answer Yes'. The deceive family (deceptive, deception, deceive, deceit, deceived, 欺骗, 骗, fragments dece/decep) is excluded at all these positions because 'deceptive' is in the question; 欺诈 (fraud) is kept as its own family. falsehood and 虚假 are treated as variants of false (borderline). 'fictional', 'scripted', 'sarcast', 'crafted', 'tone' words (polite, respectful, helpful) and role words (whistleblower, privacy) were not taken as candidates.
